sources.title: Command R7B Arabic model card
sources.evidence: Exact dated variant: developed by Cohere/Cohere Labs; open weights under CC-BY-NC with acceptable-use terms; approximately 8B total, explicitly split into 7B Transformer and 1B embedding parameters; 128,000-token text-only autoregressive Transformer, trained for Arabic/English instruction following, chat and RAG. Reopened October 27, 2026: the explicit approximately 8B complete breakdown is unchanged, and the card provides no separately defined active count.

sources.title: Introducing Command R7B Arabic
sources.evidence: Official launch page explicitly dated February 27, 2025 and titled Introducing Command R7B Arabic. Page text accessible in this audit includes headline, date and summary; model details are taken from the model card.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint public repository metadata and chat templates
sources.evidence: Public metadata at revision 2d5440c7cea22410006fb461a1b24c067683da77 names Cohere2ForCausalLM and cohere2. It exposes default, tool_use and rag templates; tool_use serializes function schemas, tool calls, tool_plan and tool results. The raw config.json request returned HTTP 401. Aggregate safetensors metadata was not treated as an independently verified learned-parameter count. Fresh October 27 metadata returns the same revision and 8,028,033,024 BF16 elements, corroborating the nominal total without supplying an active count.

sources.title: Transformers v4.49.0 Cohere2 implementation
sources.evidence: Inspected the official raw file. Cohere2ForCausalLM instantiates Cohere2Model; its decoder layers each instantiate Cohere2MLP, whose gate/up/down linear projections are evaluated densely. There is no expert router in that exact named implementation. Local/global attention matches the checkpoint card.

sources.title: Command R7B Arabic: A Small, Enterprise Focused, Multilingual, and Culturally Aware Arabic LLM
sources.evidence: March 18, 2025 first-party technical report identifies Command R7B as the starting checkpoint and describes Arabic SFT/preference tuning, cultural-knowledge and RAG evaluation. Its training experts are merged into a single general model by parameter-wise interpolation, not routed at inference. Its 7B shorthand is qualified by the model card's explicit 8B total breakdown. Independently inspected the complete report freshly fetched October 27, including Sections 3.1, 3.4 and 3.5 and all comparison headings. Named-base post-training and linear model merging do not disclose a separate active-parameter convention.

sources.title: An Overview of Cohere's Models
sources.evidence: Cohere explicitly calls command-a-reasoning-08-2025 its first reasoning model, providing a positive chronology-based classification boundary for the earlier February Arabic release. This does not deny ordinary reasoning or tool planning by older Command models.

sources.title: Reasoning Capabilities
sources.evidence: Defines the native reasoning feature as hybrid enabled/disabled thinking, dedicated thinking content blocks and optional thinking token budgets. This distinguishes the dedicated reasoning-model flag from ordinary problem-solving and tool_plan text.

sources.title: Cohere Releases Arabic-Optimized Command Model!
sources.evidence: February 27, 2025 announcement explicitly describes Command R7B Arabic as an 8-billion-parameter open-weights model with 128,000 context. Its identifier/code mistakenly reference the December base model, so exact checkpoint identity is established through the Arabic card and API metadata instead. Reopened October 27: the 8-billion total statement remains; no active count is defined.

sources.title: Command R7B base model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the exact named starting checkpoint. The card uses the 7B nominal name and defines no active count. The Arabic variant supplies its own complete 8B breakdown, so the base name does not replace that total or establish active parameters.

sources.title: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model
sources.evidence: Independently searched and inspected the complete report from the fresh October 27 primary-source fetch, including Command R7B comparisons and parameter terminology. No active/activated-parameter column or separately defined R7B count is provided; the named Arabic descendant cannot inherit an undisclosed convention.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete later report freshly fetched October 27. Table 2 distinguishes Tiny Aya embedding, non-embedding and total counts; it supplies no active count for R7B Arabic or its named base. Tiny Aya non-embedding parameters are not an applicable convention.

sources.title: Introducing Command A+
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The later family table concerns Command A variants; the explicit 218B total/25B active figures belong to A+. Neither R7B Arabic nor its base receives an active-count disclosure.

sources.title: How small AI models can make a big impact for enterprises
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model active-parameter search led to this September 2, 2026 article. It labels Command R7B as 7B parameters but reserves the explicit total/active distinction for North Mini Code (30B/3B); no R7B or Arabic active-count convention is given.

sources.title: 3LM: Bridging Arabic, STEM, and Code through Benchmarking
sources.evidence: Fresh search found the exact Arabic checkpoint in Figure 11, whose color scale says model active parameters. Table 11 lists its size as 7B. This independent benchmark paper supplies neither a Cohere active-count disclosure nor an exact-model count derivation, so it is recorded as an unresolved lead rather than a verified specification.

name.note: Exact official model name; dated checkpoint identity is c4ai-command-r7b-arabic-02-2025.

developer.note: Card credits Cohere and Cohere Labs; Cohere is the catalog developer.

family.note: Command R7B specialization, explicitly initialized from Command R7B in the technical report; existing family key is appropriate.

release_date.note: Explicit dated first-party launch announcement; exact checkpoint repository was also created that day. The March report date is later.

open_weights.note: Developer calls this an open-weights research release. Download requires acceptance of noncommercial terms; open weights does not mean unrestricted use.

license.note: Repository metadata names cc-by-nc-4.0; model card additionally requires Cohere Labs acceptable-use terms.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 card and launch checks retain the approximate nominal complete total of 8B: 7B Transformer plus 1B embedding parameters. Current Hub metadata corroborates the scale at 8.028033024B. The R7B name and report shorthand do not replace the explicit complete total; a new tensor census is unnecessary.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/named-base searches, original evidence and later first-party comparisons found no separately defined active count. The named R7B base also lacks a supported convention; dense architecture and 7B Transformer/non-embedding scope do not establish active parameters. The independent 3LM active-parameter chart provides no developer count provenance or exact-model derivation.

architecture.note: Exact checkpoint config.architectures maps to Cohere2ForCausalLM; the official implementation uses a dense MLP in every decoder layer. The report's expert merging is weight interpolation during training, not inference-time MoE routing.

context_window.note: Card explicitly gives 128,000 tokens, resolving its abbreviated 128K label.

modalities.note: Exact model card explicitly states input text only and output text only.

reasoning.note: Interpreted as dedicated native reasoning mode, not general reasoning ability. Cohere explicitly labels the later August 2025 Command A Reasoning its first reasoning model. The exact Arabic checkpoint template instead represents its thinking spans as tool_plan associated with tool calls. This is a chronology-and-protocol inference from positive evidence, not an inference from missing model-card prose.

tool_call.note: Exact released checkpoint includes a native tool_use template with function schemas, structured tool calls and tool-result turns; not merely a general prompting claim.

description.value: Open Command R model optimized for Arabic enterprise chat, RAG, and cultural knowledge
description.note: Supported by the exact card and report. Open denotes open weights with noncommercial restrictions, clarified in license/notes.

patch.notes: Approximately 8B complete parameters: 7B Transformer plus 1B embeddings, per Cohere. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. Open weights require CC-BY-NC-4.0 and Cohere Labs acceptable-use terms. The reasoning flag describes a dedicated reasoning mode; native tool planning remains supported.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained the published approximately 8B complete total and an undisclosed active count. Reopened the exact card, launch, metadata and named base; searched total/active/lineage claims and checked original and later Cohere reports and comparisons. Documented the independent 3LM active-chart lead without promoting it to a developer specification. Added explicit parameter patches and preserved all unrelated assessments; no weights or repeat census requested.
